answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 35566 Country: ZA Title: Under what circumstances is one allowed to recite the takbir of Allahu Akbar, outside of prayer and supplication Question: Under what circumstances is one allowed to recite the takbir of Allahu Akbar, outside of prayer and supplication? As for example, is one allowed to mention it in times of hearing bad news, in excitement or when one see's another Muslim performing an act of good or bad Islamic nature respectively? Answer ID: 35566 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2015/1629/B=1432) One should read انا لله وانا اليه راجعون on hearing bad news. And in other times instead of salah and dua etc you can read "Allah Akbar", it is allowed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
